review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T021. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. Values are transcribed from Nordhaus 1997 Tables 1.3, 1.5 and 1.6 and checked by two table identities.

question: Did any lighting technology that replaced an incumbent need more energy and more hours of work per lumen-hour than the incumbent when it entered?

output.domain: household lighting, Babylonian lamp to compact fluorescent 1992, mainly United States
output.accuracy: 5 percent relative tolerance per resource; transcription identities agree within 2-3 percent.

model.assumptions: Resources per unit service are energy per lumen-hour at the device and hours of work per lumen-hour; no exchange rate between them.
model.approximation: Device energy, not primary energy; the labor price of light stands for the time resource.
model.initial_boundary: Successor at its first row; incumbent at the closest row at or before that date.
model.drive_environment: Historical wages and prices as tabulated by Nordhaus.
model.parameters: No fitting; tolerance and pairs fixed in Test Card T021.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Whole table seen during transcription (SEEN_FULL), declared in Test Card T021.

system_partition.boundary: Household lighting device plus the labor that buys its fuel; published table only.

couplings.map: Historical measurement of light output, fuel use, prices and wages

observables.quantity: lumens per watt and hours of work per 1,000 lumen-hours

observation.readout: Efficiency and labor price of light.

components.reason: Resources per unit service as fixed in the card.

Pairwise classification with 5 percent tolerance; outcome rule fixed in T021.

error_budget.approximation: Device energy basis; primary energy would raise electric energy by 1/eta (eta* 0.061 and 0.095 for Edison 1883).
error_budget.measurement: Historical estimates of uncertain accuracy; Nordhaus gives no error bars.
error_budget.systematic: Transcription rebuilt from a scrambled PDF text layer; checked by two identities within 2-3 percent.
error_budget.omissions: Illegible rows (open fire, Neolithic labor, gas 1885-95 wage) not used by any pair.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T021.

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T021 comparison only; the evidence level is set in docs/standard. Not UET-distinct.
next_action: Stage 2 of test D: measure a time-energy exchange rate w_T from the trade-off pairs and test whether it is common across services.
